benchmark_claim: Mutation-detection comparison on frozen source-equivalent A2 projections. The frozen V0.11 source-equivalence certificate remains the evidence for source-level correctness.

interpretation.bizproof: Frozen V0.11 symbolic result: correct adapter equivalent to the certified source slice and mutant disproved.
interpretation.crosshair: Assertion-based symbolic search on the same frozen projection. No reported counterexample is not credited as source-level proof.
interpretation.hypothesis: Counterexample search only. No counterexample within a budget is inconclusive.

selection_rule: Primary matched baseline includes frozen CERTIFIED_A2 candidates with a standalone correct adapter, a standalone mutant, identical function signatures, and argument types limited to scalar int/bool, optional scalar, finite tuple/sequence, or Decimal.
